Module io.github.brantunger.unruly.core
Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.exception

Class RuleCompilationException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.exception.UnrulyException
io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.exception.RuleCompilationException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class RuleCompilationException extends UnrulyException
Exception thrown when a rule fails to compile, or when several do.

RulesEngine.load(java.util.List) compiles every rule before it throws, so one exception reports everything that failed: failures() has one exception for each broken rule, for a language that couldn't create its compiler and for each declared fact name the languages reject, and the name, expression kind and issues of this exception are those of the first. A failure that isn't a rule's has no rule name.

      public RuleCompilationException(@Nullable String message, List<RuleCompilationException> failures)

  • Method Details

    • getRuleName

      public @Nullable String getRuleName()
      Returns the name of the rule that failed, as Rule.getRuleName() returns it. Unlike the message, it isn't escaped or shortened, so it can be used to look the rule up.
      Returns:
      The rule's name, or null if the failure isn't about one rule (for example an expression language failed to create its compiler, or an element of the list is null)

    • getExpressionKind

      public @Nullable ExpressionKind getExpressionKind()
      Returns whether the rule's condition or its action failed.

    • failures

      public List<RuleCompilationException> failures()
      Returns every failure of the load, in the order they were found: each broken rule's, in priority order; a language that couldn't create its compiler, in place of the first rule that needed it; and each declared fact name the languages reject, last. Only a rule's failure has a rule name.
      Returns:
      One exception for each failure, or only this exception if there was one; unmodifiable
